name: sweden

events.event: The outcome of the election may not be decided until Wednesday, when local election boards count early votes that did not make it to the polling stations by Election Day.
variants: 最终结果何时出来有两个口径：多数文章（991959:5 / 995219:6 / 994815:8）称周三点完迟到的邮寄票/海外票即可定音；999871:21 则称『海外票周三点完后，最终选举结果要到周末才出』。清单锁死『周三』这一口径。另：周三所点票种的表述也不同——991959/995219 称 early votes，994815 称 postal votes + ballots cast from abroad，990477:10 只提海外票。
多数源（991959:5、995219:6、994815:8、990477:10、998324:15、997267:10）暗示结果可能在周三（清点海外/迟到选票后）明朗；但 999871:21 明确说'周三清点海外选票后，最终结果要到周末才出'——与清单暗示的'周三见分晓'口径不一致，判官需知道有这个更晚的时间线说法。

events.event: The Sweden Democrats' support slipped almost 3 per cent from its 2022 result of 20.5 per cent and it fell from second to third place.

With 92 per cent of the vote counted early Monday, the Swedish Election Authority reported the four opposition parties were heading for 175 seats in the 349-seat parliament to 174 seats for the government alliance.
variants: 清单写'175席对174席'，逐字照抄 991959:4（92%选票计票时的口径）。但更多源在计票比例更高时报的是'176对173'：995219:5（94%）、1003988:3（周一）、998324:14/997267:9（95%，'三席多数'）。同一事实随计票进度变化出现两个口径，清单锁死了较早、较少见的那个。

events.event: Andersson told supporters that 'we must wait for the final election result' but added that 'right now we are leading'.
Kristersson said he would explore 'possibilities' given the close result.
With 95% of votes counted, the left-leaning opposition bloc led by Magdalena Andersson widened its lead to three seats, leading 176 to 173 against the reigning centre-right coalition.
variants: 与 995865:2、999871:2 的'176对173'一致，但这与 #3 登记的'175对174'（991959:4，92%计票时）是同一件事在不同计票进度下的两个口径，二者不应被判官当成两条独立且互斥的事实。

events.event: With 95 percent of votes counted on Monday, the four opposition parties held a three-seat majority in the 349-seat parliament over Prime Minister Kristersson's right-wing alliance.
Kristersson said there is a very clear non-socialist majority, or non-left leaning economic majority in the Swedish parliament.
Parliament can vote on a new prime minister on September 29 at the earliest.
SVT projected the right-wing bloc led by Ulf Kristersson was virtually tied with the centre-left opposition led by Magdalena Andersson.
Jimmie Åkesson said that 'we will not know tonight' who will form the next government.
The Social Democrats held onto first place with a 28.1 percent share.
Magdalena Andersson started coalition negotiations to form a new government.
The Centre party said it would seek a government with a clear centre-right character.

caveat: 基准从原文独立抽,未经人工核。glm-flash 的抽取质量没有独立验过 —— 覆盖率的绝对值据此打折读,臂间相对比较不受影响(各臂共用同一份)。

droppedExamples: Kosovo lawmakers voted to approve a new government led by Prime Minister Albin Kurti on September 13, 2026.
Kosovo's parliament failed to elect deputy speakers of the assembly on September 13, 2026.
Yong Hye-in, a lawmaker of the minor Basic Income Party, pulled out of consideration for the position of gender minister.
The Centrist Reform Alliance (CRA) is set to split into two groups.
impurityFilter.note: 后置过滤:整条出处都是杂质文章的事件删除,幸存事件里的杂质 articleId 剔除后重算 nArticles/nSources 与分层。事件措辞未重抽。

coreAudit.note: 只校核了核心层(设门那一层)。次层/尾层未校核;「该有而没抽到」与「支持篇数算错导致的错误分层」两类失效结构上查不到,见 decision-hold-checklist-tiering

trail.was: The Swedish Election Authority reported the four opposition parties were heading for 175 seats in the 349-seat parliament to 174 seats for the government alliance.
trail.now: With 92 per cent of the vote counted early Monday, the Swedish Election Authority reported the four opposition parties were heading for 175 seats in the 349-seat parliament to 174 seats for the government alliance.
trail.why: 数字本身忠于 991959:4，但清单删掉了原句的『With 92 per cent of the vote counted early Monday』这一时点限定，使一个随计票推进而变化的中间快照被写成无条件事实，与簇内 176–173 的更晚口径直接打架；且与本清单 #6（95% 时 176–173）是同一事实的两条互斥登记。另：登记的 3 篇支持里，994815:5 讲的是比例代表制与 4% 门槛，与本条无关，实际只有 2 篇支持且二者数字不同。
